The '''Ja Knoll''' was a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. The [[Eriadu Manufacturing Shipyards]]' administrative offices were located atop of Ja Knoll. The location shared its name with the [[Ja highlands]].<ref name="GatORW" />
